documents.title: Doc 54 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 25 - VSC infringement
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 25 - VSC infringement

details.fact: Car 25 (Nakamura) failed to stay above the VSC minimum delta time at the end of the VSC period.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 41.5 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations
details.decision: Five seconds (5) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (a) of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 1 penalty point to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 1 penalty point.
details.reason: The Stewards examined timing data evidence. Car 25 (NAK) breached the VSC minimum delta time by 1.1 seconds at the end of the VSC period. documents.title: Doc 53 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 5 - Leaving track and gaining an advantage
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 5 - Leaving track and gaining an advantage

details.fact: Car 5 (Slater) left the track and gained an advantage.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Five seconds (5) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (a) of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Car 5 (SLA) was on the outside of Car 10 (KAT) at Turn 1, without enough overlap to establish his right to racing room. SLA exceeded track limits when approaching Turn 2, rejoined in front of KAT, and retained the position. The Stewards determined that SLA left the track and gained a lasting advantage. In determining the penalty, the Stewards considered the fact that this incident occurred at Turn 2 on Lap 1 as mitigating circumstances.

documents.title: Doc 47 - DECISION - Car 18 - Right of Review
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 18 - Right of Review

details.fact: Car 18 (Badoer) made nose to tail contact with Car 3 (Rivera) at turn 14 after Car 3 experienced an electrical problem and loss of power.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: In relation to the penalty applied to Car 18 in Document 30 we determine: a. The penalty is rescinded. b. The 10 seconds added to the elapsed race time of Car 18 on the provisional results shall be removed when preparing and issuing the final classification. c. The two (2) penalty points added to the driver’s record shall be removed. Total for the 2026 season = 0 points. d. No Further Action is taken in relation to the collision between Car 18 and Car 3 at Turn 14.
details.reason: During the Sprint Race, the Stewards issued an in-race 10 seconds penalty to Car 18 (BAD) for causing a collision with Car 3 (RIV). This penalty was issued during the session without a hearing based on the video evidence available. After the Sprint Race, the Team Manager of RIV informed the Stewards that RIV suffered an electrical failure on the exit of Turn 14 which caused it to lose power. The Stewards, having determined that this information constituted a significant, new and relevant element that was unavailable to them at the time of the decision, decided to re- examine Decision Document N. 30, pursuant Article 14.1.2 of the FIA International Sporting Code. The team representatives were summoned and heard. The Team Manager of RIV confirmed the technical failure which caused the loss of power of RIV at Turn 14 while BAD was approaching at full speed. The Team Manager of BAD stated that the driver had no time to react and to avoid RIV in front of him, who was losing power and speed. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that BAD was merely trying to avoid a stricken car, that he tried his best to avoid RIV, and that neither driver is wholly or predominantly responsible for the collision. Accordingly, the findings and penalties set forth in Document 30 are hereby vacated and revised as set forth herein.

documents.title: Doc 46 - DECISION - Car 17 - Allegedly involved in a collision with Car 6
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 17 - Allegedly involved in a collision with Car 6

details.fact: Car 6 (De Palo) and Car 17 (Clerot) collided at T1
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: No Further Action
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Car 17 (CLE) attempted an outside overtake on Car 6 (DEP) at turn 1. CLE was ahead of DEP at the apex of turn 1 with approximately half of the car in front of DEP. As CLE turned in a collision occurred between the right-rear wheel of CLE and left-front wheel of DEP. DEP spun and lost several positions while CLE continued without any disadvantage. During the hearing, both drivers acknowledged that the other had respected their right to racing room and that the collision was a consequence of racing circumstances. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determine that neither driver was wholly or predominantly responsible for the collision. Based on the totality of the circumstances, the Stewards elect to take no further action.

documents.title: Doc 41 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 30 - Leaving the track and gaining an advantage
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 30 - Leaving the track and gaining an advantage

details.fact: Car 30 (Bhirombhakdi) went off track at Turn 2 gaining lasting advantage.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 12.4.1.h of the FIA International Sporting Code. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Approaching T1 – T 2, Car 28 (BAR) was fighting for position with Car 24 (MCL), while both cars were overtaking Car 30 (BHI) which was on the outside. As the three cars were alongside each other at the exit of turn 1, BHI left the track and subsequently rejoined after turn 2 in front of BAR and MCL, overtaking them. BHI didn’t give the position back afterwards. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that BHI gained a lasting advantage by leaving the track. Accordingly, the standard penalty was applied.

documents.title: Doc 40 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 19 - Leaving the track and gaining an advantage
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 19 - Leaving the track and gaining an advantage

details.fact: Car 19 (CHO) went off track at T1 - T2 gaining lasting advantage.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 12.4.1.h of the FIA International Sporting Code. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Approaching Turn 1, Car 28 (BAR) attempted an overtake on the inside of Car 19 (CHO). While defending his position, CHO left the track and subsequently rejoined at Turn 2 fully ahead of BAR. When a car goes off track while defending, it is generally expected that they concede the position. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that by retaining a position that he should have properly conceded, CHO retained a lasting advantage. Accordingly, the standard penalty was applied.

documents.title: Doc 35 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 19 - False start - Out of position
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 19 - False start - Out of position

details.fact: Car 19 was out of position at the start of the race, taking the vacant position left by Car 6.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 37.15 of the 2026 FIA Formula 3 Championship Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A Drive-Through penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (c) of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. As the penalty was imposed after the race, it is converted to 20 seconds added to the elapsed race time of the Driver concerned in accordance with Article 39.3 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. There are no penalty points associated with this infraction.
details.reason: Car 7 started from the pit lane, causing its grid spot to be empty as other cars started to form up the grid. Car 11, which was supposed to start directly behind Car 7 in 17th position on the grid, moved up to Car 7’s spot. Car 6 followed Car 11’s movement and took up its space. Car 19, in turn, took up car 6’s space on the grid, occupying now the 19th grid spot rather than the correct 21st grid spot. The Stewards consider that the advantage gained is significant enough to warrant an increased penalty for this type of infringement, and therefore consider the applied drive-through penalty appropriate and proportional.

documents.title: Doc 20 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - Impeding of Car 28 in Qualifying
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - Impeding of Car 28 in Qualifying

details.fact: Car 11 (Gladysz) impeded Car 28 (Barrichello) on the approach to Turn 10 during the Qualifying Session.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A drop of three grid positions for both races (Sprint and Feature Races) at this Competition. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video and GPS evidence They summoned and heard the drivers and team representatives (documents 16 & 17). Approaching Turn 10, Car 28 (BAR) was on a push lap. Car 11 (GLA), which had already aborted its lap, was driving slowly on the racing line at Turn 10. GLA explained that he saw BAR exceed track limits at Turn 9, that he thought that BAR was not pushing anymore, and that he did not expect his approach. Notwithstanding the fact that BAR exceeded track limits, the stewards determine that he was still entitled to push because he did not realize at the time that he had exceeded track limits. BAR was also entitled to keep pushing because the clock was running down and he had the chance to commence another push lap. GLA could have taken steps to avoid unnecessarily impeding BAR, but he did not do so. Accordingly, the Stewards apply the standard penalty for this infringement in a Qualifying session.
